limitations: Results measure production-compiled app journeys using fixed service delays and real cached JPEG fixtures in Chromium, not current live-network latency or native WebKit interaction performance.

Baseline source is the preserved 81986e5 checkout at /tmp/mpc-front-scroll/baseline; fixture JPEG paths in fixtures.json refer to the original local thumbnail cache and must be provided on another machine.
The prior interrupted partial final series was restarted as a complete alternating series; final-results.json and followup-results.json define the acceptance dataset.
Native smoke verifies startup/rendering only. No comprehensive correctness or authenticated end-to-end guarantee is inferred from passing tests.
